title: Declined Work shows in its own section with names and descriptions only
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. A document exists whose work order has declined work lines (with names, descriptions, and internal scope-of-work notes), and the "Show declined work" option is enabled.
steps:
1. Generate the Estimate or Invoice.
2. Find the Declined Work section and read its lines.
expected:
1. Declined work appears in its own section headed exactly "Declined Work", separate from the main work section.
2. Each declined line shows its name, and its description when a description is present.
3. A declined line never shows a scope-of-work note (the technician's internal write-up) - that note does not print for declined work on any customer document.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9145 (Story 6, Declined Work) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 38, sections S6-R1 and S6-R2, read on 21 August 2026.

title: Declined lines show no prices, no line numbers, and no status pill
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. A document exists with declined work lines and "Show declined work" enabled.
steps:
1. Generate the document.
2. Read the Declined Work section and check the totals elsewhere on the document.
expected:
1. Declined lines show no prices, no labor totals, and no parts totals.
2. Declined lines are never included in any total on the document.
3. Declined lines do not show a line number.
4. No status pill is shown on declined lines; the "Declined Work" heading is the only indicator of declined status.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9145 (Story 6, Declined Work) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 38, sections S6-R3, S6-R4 and S6-R5, read on 21 August 2026.

title: Declined Work section hidden when nothing declined or option off
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can reach a document with no declined lines, and one that has declined lines but with "Show declined work" turned off.
steps:
1. Generate a document with no declined lines; look for a Declined Work section.
2. Generate a document that has declined lines but with "Show declined work" off; look for a Declined Work section.
expected:
1. When there are no declined lines, the Declined Work section is not shown.
2. When the "Show declined work" option is off, the Declined Work section is not shown even if declined lines exist.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9145 (Story 6, Declined Work) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 38, section S6-N1, read on 21 August 2026.
